result.summary: The UI appears functional, but there is one notable issue with image rendering and one potential concern regarding text clarity in the 'Popular right now' section.

issues.description: The restaurant image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' is clipped significantly, showing only a small portion of the ramen bowl.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the aspect ratio or CSS object-fit property (e.g., 'object-fit: cover' or 'contain') to ensure the representative food image is fully visible within the container.

issues.description: The white text on the light-colored background for the '-20%' offer badge at the bottom is low-contrast and difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Increase the contrast of the badge by using a darker background color or adding a subtle drop shadow to the text.
